name: Sqlitebrowser
tagline: A high quality, visual, open source tool to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.
description: DB Browser for SQLite is a high quality, visual, open source tool to create, design, and edit database files compatible with SQLite.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/sqlitebrowser:18.04.1@sha256:03f747bdf1f035d0752693cb0ff415a508badaf0de28bfe7a1765009c51ed6ed
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
